question: What do the two countings of a structure's allowed states (every state of the finished structure once; every state of the start once, each birth's completions sharing its old state's weight equally) give, side by side, on the record's weighted statements that can be recomputed; does the lemma hold that, counted from a start before the settings, a four-correlation score over setting births is at most 2 under its registered hypotheses; and which rules of the settings line's structures are knots in the whole structure?
inputs: The 33 structures, the construction orders, the census starts, the table of statements, the options, outcome classes and bounds named in the pre-registration and its data files; this study's definitions and claim and its knot-test finding; the records of the earlier studies the table cites, as published; the shared definitions and those of PARTS-MEET-AGAIN-20261124-001; the canonical knot checker; the engine of PARTS-MEET-AGAIN-20261124-001A, unchanged, read-only.
forbidden_inputs: Any definition changed after a value is seen; for the engine's author, the drafter's scratch prototype and anything it produced beyond what the pre-registration, the finding and the data files disclose; any change to a frozen engine or to another study's record; any choice between the countings presented as a result.
primary_observable: For every row of the table marked for recomputation: its value under counting from the finish, under counting from the start and from each common stage between, with the verdict unchanged, changed (by how much) or not recomputed (why); for every registered settings structure and example, the score for the registered classes of outcome functions, whether each record is hidden, and which hypotheses of the lemma it meets, with the three-way verdict; the classification of the construction orders; for every knot of every registered structure, the relation it induces in the whole structure and its verdict under K1, K2 and K3, by projection and, up to the registered size, by the canonical checker.
comparators_or_controls: Brute-force enumeration against the engine on the smallest structures; the record's own published numbers as reproductions; one built example breaking each hypothesis of the lemma; the construction orders as the swap of taking a hand-built structure as its own start; starts renumbered and grown again under the rules that choose by name; each rule tested on its own beside its test in the whole.
resource_budget: About twenty minutes in all on at most 6 processes at the measured rates, at most about an hour with every registered cap reached, each process under a memory cap; parts run in the registered order; a part that reaches its count-based cut is reported as cut, with what was not run named.
first_executable_signal: The gates: brute force equals the engine on the smallest structures, and the record's 20/9 and 2 are reproduced. Then the knot test of the 11-knot structure in the whole.
decision_rule: Each prediction is judged by its 'Fails when' entry; checks of the code, replications of the scratch runs, arguments and classifications from the record are marked as such. The lemma's verdict on a structure is one of three: hypotheses met and at most 2; hypotheses met and above 2 (the lemma or the engine is wrong); a hypothesis fails (which one, score reported).
stop_rule: Stop when every registered part is done in its registered order or reported as cut, every row of the table has its verdict, every registered structure has its lemma verdict and its knot column, and every prediction has a verdict.
nonclaims: An exploratory study, mostly a compilation of the record with a few recomputations. Neither counting is the owner's: he left the choice open, and the thread keeps counting from the finish as its working choice, reversible and not tested here; the excess on the settings line is what that choice produces and is not evidence for it. The laws use no value and make the same structures under either counting, so no run decides between them. The table is what the listed searches found, not a census of the record. The literature's names for the four-correlation test are given once. No claim about physics.
